story: After King You was killed and Haojing sacked in 771 BCE, the Marquis of Shen and his allies put the former crown prince Yijiu on the throne as King Ping. The old capital was in ruins, and the Rong peoples now controlled much of the Wei valley.

In 770 BCE King Ping moved the court east to Luoyi, the second capital built by the Duke of Zhou. Qin troops escorted him. Another faction had crowned a rival, King Xie, and for some years there were two Zhou kings, until Marquis Wen of Jin killed King Xie.
This move marks the start of the Eastern Zhou. The king kept his rituals and his title, but he had little land and no strong army. He now depended on the lords who had put him on the throne.
story_zh: 公元前771年幽王被杀、镐京被毁之后，申侯等诸侯拥立原太子宜臼为王，即周平王。旧都已成废墟，渭河谷地大部分落入戎人之手。
公元前770年，平王在秦军护送下把朝廷东迁到洛邑，也就是周公当年营建的东都。另有一派贵族拥立了周携王，一度出现两个周王并立的局面，直到晋文侯杀死携王。
这次东迁标志着东周的开始。周王仍保留着礼仪和名号，但土地很少，也没有强大的军队，只能依靠拥立他的诸侯。
move-east.why: The move east turned the Zhou king into a symbol and opened five centuries in which the great states fought for power.
move-east.why_zh: 东迁使周王沦为象征性的共主，此后五百多年，各大诸侯国展开了激烈的争霸。

people.name: Marquis of Shen
people.role_zh: 平王的外祖父和支持者

people.name: Marquis Wen of Jin
people.role: Jin ruler who backed King Ping

story: When Duke Xiang of Qi was murdered in 686 BCE, two of his brothers raced home to claim the throne. Guan Zhong, who served the rival prince, shot an arrow at Prince Xiaobai, but it struck his belt buckle. Xiaobai won the race and became Duke Huan.

Instead of punishing Guan Zhong, Duke Huan made him chief minister on the advice of his friend Bao Shuya. Qi grew rich and strong. In 679 BCE the lords met at Juan and accepted Duke Huan as their leader, the first hegemon.

Under the slogan 'honour the king, expel the barbarians', Qi defended Yan against the Shanrong, rescued Xing and Wey from the Di, and checked Chu. But when Duke Huan died in 643 BCE his sons fought over the throne, and his body lay unburied for more than two months.
story_zh: 公元前686年齐襄公被杀，他的两个弟弟争相赶回国内夺取君位。辅佐另一位公子的管仲向公子小白射了一箭，正中带钩。小白抢先回国即位，就是齐桓公。
齐桓公听从好友鲍叔牙的建议，不但没有报复管仲，还任命他为国相。齐国由此富强起来。公元前679年，诸侯在鄄地会盟，推举齐桓公为盟主，他成为春秋第一位霸主。
齐国打着“尊王攘夷”的旗号，帮燕国打退山戎，救援被狄人攻破的邢国和卫国，并遏制了楚国的北进。可是公元前643年桓公死后，几个儿子争夺君位，他的尸体两个多月无人收殓。
duke-huan.why: Duke Huan created the role of hegemon, a strong lord who led the others in the king's name, which shaped politics for the next two centuries.
duke-huan.why_zh: 齐桓公开创了“霸主”这一角色，即以周王名义号令诸侯的强国国君，这一模式影响了此后两百年的政局。

people.name: Duke Huan of Qi
people.role: Ruler of Qi and first hegemon

people.name: Bao Shuya
people.role: Duke Huan's adviser who recommended Guan Zhong

quote.zh: 桓公九合诸侯，不以兵车，管仲之力也。
quote.en: Duke Huan gathered the lords nine times without using war chariots; this was Guan Zhong's doing.
quote.from: Analects, Xian Wen 论语·宪问

story: Duke Xian of Jin wanted to destroy Guo, a state south of the Yellow River. The easiest route ran through the small state of Yu. His minister Xun Xi suggested bribing the lord of Yu with fine horses from Qu and a precious jade from Chuiji.

The lord of Yu accepted and let the Jin army pass. In 658 BCE Jin took the Guo town of Xiayang. In 655 BCE Jin asked again. The Yu minister Gong Zhiqi warned that Yu and Guo depended on each other like lips and teeth: when the lips are gone, the teeth feel the cold. The lord ignored him, and Gong Zhiqi left the country with his family.
That winter Jin captured Shangyang, the capital of Guo. On the way back, the army camped in Yu and took it by surprise, recovering the horses and jade.
story_zh: 晋献公想灭掉黄河以南的虢国，而最方便的路线要经过小国虞国。大臣荀息建议用屈地出产的良马和垂棘出产的美玉贿赂虞国国君。
虞君收下礼物，允许晋军借道。公元前658年，晋国攻占了虢国的下阳。公元前655年，晋国再次借道。虞国大臣宫之奇劝谏说，虞和虢就像嘴唇和牙齿一样互相依存，嘴唇没了，牙齿就会受冻。虞君不听，宫之奇只好带着家族离开了虞国。
这年冬天，晋军攻下虢国都城上阳。回师途中，晋军驻扎在虞国，趁其不备一举灭虞，那几匹良马和美玉也被收了回去。
guo-yu.why: Jin gained control of the passes along the Yellow River, opening its way into the Central Plain and toward great-power status.
guo-yu.why_zh: 晋国控制了黄河沿岸的要道，打开了进入中原的通道，为成为大国奠定了基础。

people.name: Xun Xi
people.role: Jin minister who planned the bribe

people.name: Gong Zhiqi
people.role: Yu minister who warned his lord

quote.zh: 辅车相依，唇亡齿寒。
quote.en: Jaw and cheek depend on each other; when the lips are gone, the teeth are cold.
quote.from: Zuo Commentary, Duke Xi year 5 左传·僖公五年

story: By 633 BCE Chu dominated the south and was besieging Song, an ally of Jin. Duke Wen of Jin, recently returned from exile, attacked Chu's allies Cao and Wey to draw the Chu army north.

When the armies met in 632 BCE, Duke Wen pulled his troops back three days' march, keeping a promise he had made to King Cheng of Chu while in exile. The Chu commander Ziyu followed. At Chengpu, Jin, with Qi, Qin and Song, struck. Jin chariots with horses covered in tiger skins scattered the troops of Chen and Cai on the Chu right, while other Jin units feigned retreat, drew the Chu left forward and then struck it from the side.
Ziyu withdrew and later killed himself. Soon after, King Xiang of Zhou formally named Duke Wen leader of the lords at the covenant of Jiantu.
story_zh: 到公元前633年，楚国称雄南方，正围攻晋国的盟国宋国。刚结束流亡回国的晋文公出兵攻打楚国的盟友曹、卫，想把楚军引向北方。
公元前632年两军相遇时，晋文公命令军队后撤三天的路程，兑现了他流亡时对楚成王许下的诺言。楚军主帅子玉紧追不舍。晋军联合齐、秦、宋在城濮发起进攻：晋军战马蒙上虎皮冲击楚军右翼的陈、蔡军队，使其溃散；晋军另一部分则假装后退，引楚军左翼追击，再从侧面夹击。
子玉收兵撤退，后来自杀。不久，周襄王在践土之盟上正式册命晋文公为诸侯之长。
chengpu.why: Chengpu stopped Chu's advance into the north for a generation and made Jin the leading state for most of the next century.
chengpu.why_zh: 城濮之战使楚国北进的势头停顿了一代人之久，晋国在此后近百年的大部分时间里都是头号强国。

quote.zh: 晋、楚治兵，遇于中原，其辟君三舍。
quote.en: If Jin and Chu draw up their armies and meet on the central plain, I will withdraw three days' march before you.
quote.from: Zuo Commentary, Duke Xi year 23 左传·僖公二十三年

story: Lai was an old state of the Yi people on the eastern Shandong peninsula, a neighbour of Qi since Qi was founded. The two fought on and off for centuries, and Qi raided it several times in the 600s and 500s BCE.

In 567 BCE Duke Ling of Qi sent his minister Yan Ruo against Lai. Yan Ruo had already built a fortified town nearby to press on Lai. Now he laid siege to its capital and took it. The ruler of Lai fled to the town of Tang, which fell soon after, and the Zuo Commentary records that the people of Lai were moved to Ni.
With Lai gone, Qi held the whole peninsula, including its coast, salt works and fisheries. Yan Ruo was the father of Yan Ying, who would serve as Qi's famous minister.
story_zh: 莱国是山东半岛东部夷人的古国，自齐国建国起就是它的邻居。两国时战时和，延续了几百年，公元前七世纪和六世纪齐国曾多次出兵攻莱。
公元前567年，齐灵公派大臣晏弱攻打莱国。晏弱此前已在附近筑城，对莱国步步紧逼，这次他包围并攻破了莱国都城。莱君逃到棠邑，棠邑不久也被攻破。据《左传》记载，莱国百姓被迁到了郳。
灭莱之后，齐国占有了整个山东半岛，包括沿海地区和那里的盐场、渔场。晏弱的儿子就是后来齐国的名相晏婴。
qi-lai.why: Taking Lai doubled Qi's coastline and its salt and fish resources, which helped make Qi one of the richest states of the era.
qi-lai.why_zh: 灭莱使齐国的海岸线和盐、渔资源大大增加，帮助齐国成为当时最富庶的国家之一。

story: Kong Qiu, known as Kongzi or Confucius, was born in 551 BCE near Qufu in the state of Lu. His father, an old soldier, died when he was a child, and he grew up poor. He studied the rites and old texts and became a teacher, taking students whatever their background.

Around 500 BCE he served Lu as minister of justice. Frustrated by the powerful families who controlled Lu, he left in 497 BCE and spent about fourteen years travelling among states such as Wey, Song, Chen and Cai, looking for a ruler who would follow his advice. None did.
He returned to Lu in 484 BCE, taught and, by tradition, edited the old classics. He died in 479 BCE. His students collected his sayings in the Analects.
story_zh: 孔丘，后世尊称孔子，公元前551年生于鲁国曲阜附近。父亲是一位老武士，在他幼年时去世，他从小家境贫寒。他学习礼仪和古代典籍，后来开门授徒，不论出身贵贱都收为学生。
大约公元前500年，他在鲁国担任司寇。由于不满鲁国被几大贵族世家把持，他在公元前497年离开鲁国，在卫、宋、陈、蔡等国之间周游约十四年，寻找愿意采纳他主张的君主，却始终没有找到。
公元前484年，他回到鲁国，专心教学，相传还整理了古代典籍。公元前479年孔子去世，弟子们把他的言论汇编成《论语》。
confucius.why: Confucius's ideas on virtue, ritual, family and good government became the core of Chinese education and statecraft for more than two thousand years.
confucius.why_zh: 孔子关于德行、礼仪、家庭和善政的思想，在两千多年里一直是中国教育和治国理念的核心。

people.name: Zilu
people.role: Student and companion on his travels

quote.zh: 有教无类。
quote.en: In teaching there should be no distinction of class.
quote.from: Analects, Wei Ling Gong 论语·卫灵公

story: In 515 BCE Prince Guang of Wu had King Liao assassinated and took the throne as King Helü. Two of Liao's brothers, who were leading an army abroad, fled. One of them found refuge in Xu, an old state on the lower Huai River.

Helü demanded that Xu hand him over. When Xu let him escape to Chu instead, Wu attacked in 512 BCE. The Wu army built dykes from the hills and flooded the Xu capital. The ruler of Xu, Zhangyu, cut off his hair as a sign of submission and came out to surrender, then fled to Chu.
Wu Zixu then proposed a plan to wear Chu down: split the Wu army into three groups and raid Chu in turn, so that Chu would exhaust itself responding.
story_zh: 公元前515年，吴国公子光派人刺杀吴王僚，夺取王位，就是吴王阖闾。吴王僚的两个弟弟当时正领兵在外，只好出逃，其中一人逃到了淮河下游的古国徐国。
阖闾要求徐国交出此人，徐国却放他逃往楚国。公元前512年，吴国出兵攻徐，依山筑堤，引水灌入徐国都城。徐君章禹剪断头发以示臣服，出城投降，随后逃往楚国。
伍子胥随即提出疲楚之策：把吴军分为三支，轮番袭扰楚国，让楚国疲于奔命。
wu-xu.why: Taking Xu cleared Wu's path into the Huai valley and set up the great attack on Chu six years later.
wu-xu.why_zh: 灭徐为吴国打开了进入淮河流域的通道，也为六年后大举攻楚做好了准备。

story: In 506 BCE Wu, allied with the small states of Tang and Cai, launched a full invasion of Chu. The army sailed up the Huai River, then left its boats and crossed the passes into the Han valley.

The Chu commander Nang Wa crossed the Han River to meet them. The two armies clashed at Boju, and the vanguard of Fugai, Helü's brother, broke the Chu line. Wu chased the fleeing army, won several more battles, and entered the Chu capital Ying. King Zhao of Chu fled. The Records of the Grand Historian say Wu Zixu dug up the body of King Ping, who had killed his father, and whipped it.
The Chu official Shen Baoxu went to Qin and wept at its court for seven days until Qin sent an army. With Qin attacking and Yue raiding Wu, Helü withdrew in 505 BCE.
story_zh: 公元前506年，吴国联合唐、蔡两个小国，全力进攻楚国。吴军沿淮河逆流而上，然后舍舟登陆，翻越关隘进入汉水流域。
楚军主帅囊瓦渡过汉水迎战，两军在柏举交锋，阖闾之弟夫概率领先头部队冲垮了楚军阵线。吴军乘胜追击，又连胜数仗，攻入楚都郢，楚昭王出逃。据《史记》记载，伍子胥掘开杀父仇人楚平王的坟墓，鞭打他的尸体。
楚国大夫申包胥到秦国求救，在秦廷痛哭七天七夜，秦国终于出兵。在秦军反攻、越国又袭击吴国后方的情况下，阖闾于公元前505年撤军。
boju.why: Boju was the first time a southeastern state crushed a major power, making Wu a leading state and nearly destroying Chu.
boju.why_zh: 柏举之战是东南方国家首次击溃一个大国，吴国由此跻身强国之列，楚国则几乎亡国。

people.name: Shen Baoxu
people.role: Chu official who won Qin's help

story: The Qin rulers descended from Feizi, a horse breeder whom a Zhou king had rewarded with land, and they had spent generations fighting the Rong on the western frontier. When the Quanrong sacked Haojing in 771 BCE, Duke Xiang of Qin led his troops to help the Zhou and fought hard.

In 770 BCE he escorted King Ping east to Luoyi. In return King Ping made him a full lord, equal in rank to the older states, and promised him the old Zhou homeland west of Mount Qi, if Qin could take it back from the Rong.
Duke Xiang died on campaign a few years later. His son Duke Wen defeated the Rong and took the lands up to Mount Qi, moving Qin into the rich Wei valley.
story_zh: 秦国君主是非子的后代。非子因为善于养马，曾被周王封赏土地，此后秦人世代在西部边境与戎人作战。公元前771年犬戎攻破镐京时，秦襄公率兵救周，作战十分勇猛。
公元前770年，他护送周平王东迁洛邑。作为回报，平王把他正式封为诸侯，与老牌诸侯国同等地位，并许诺：只要秦能从戎人手中夺回岐山以西的周人故地，这片土地就归秦所有。
几年后，秦襄公死于征战途中。他的儿子秦文公打败戎人，夺取了直到岐山的土地，秦国由此进入富饶的渭河谷地。
qin-becomes-state.why: Becoming a full state and taking the old Zhou homeland gave Qin the base from which it would unite China five centuries later.
qin-becomes-state.why_zh: 正式立国并占有周人故地，为秦国五百多年后统一中国打下了根基。

people.name: King Ping of Zhou
people.role: Zhou king who granted the title

people.name: Duke Wen of Qin
people.role: Son who took the Wei valley

quote.zh: 平王封襄公为诸侯，赐之岐以西之地。
quote.en: King Ping made Duke Xiang a lord of the realm and granted him the lands west of Mount Qi.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian, Annals of Qin 史记·秦本纪

story: Each Zhou state kept an official record of events. The chronicle of Lu is the only one that survives. It begins in 722 BCE, the first year of Duke Yin of Lu, and ends in 481 BCE, covering 242 years in very short entries: battles, treaties, deaths of rulers, eclipses and floods.

Because each year's entries were filed under spring, summer, autumn and winter, the book was called the Spring and Autumn, and modern historians use that name for the whole period from 770 to 476 BCE.

Tradition says Confucius edited the chronicle, choosing words carefully to praise or blame. Three commentaries explain it. The longest, the Zuo Commentary, adds detailed stories and is the main source for the history of this era.
story_zh: 周代各诸侯国都有官方记录史事的史书，留存至今的只有鲁国的这一部。它从公元前722年（鲁隐公元年）开始，到公元前481年结束，共记载了242年间的大事，文字极为简练：战争、盟会、国君去世、日食和水灾等等。
由于每年的记事按春、夏、秋、冬四季排列，这部书被称为《春秋》，现代史学家也用这个名字来称呼公元前770年至前476年这个时代。
相传孔子修订过这部史书，用字斟酌，寓褒贬于其中。解释它的有三部传，其中篇幅最长的《左传》补充了大量具体故事，是研究这一时代历史最主要的资料。
spring-autumn-annals-begin.why: The chronicle gave the era its name, and its tradition of precise year-by-year records shaped how Chinese history was written ever after.
spring-autumn-annals-begin.why_zh: 这部史书为一个时代命名，它逐年精确记事的传统也深刻影响了此后中国的历史书写。

people.name: Zuo Qiuming
people.role: Traditional author of the Zuo Commentary

quote.zh: 孔子成《春秋》而乱臣贼子惧。
quote.en: When Confucius completed the Spring and Autumn, rebellious ministers and murderous sons were afraid.
quote.from: Mencius, Teng Wen Gong II 孟子·滕文公下

story: Duke Zhuang of Zheng was both a minister at the Zhou court and the ruler of a strong state next to it. He often acted against the king's wishes. In 707 BCE King Huan of Zhou removed him from office, and when the duke stopped coming to court, the king led an army against Zheng with troops from Chen, Cai and Wey.

The two sides met at Xuge. Zheng attacked the weak allied wings first, and they broke. Then Zheng closed in on the royal centre, using a tight 'fish-scale' formation of chariots and infantry. The royal army was routed, and the Zheng officer Zhu Dan hit the king in the shoulder with an arrow.
Zhu Dan wanted to chase the king, but Duke Zhuang held him back. That night he sent an envoy to ask after the king's health and that of his officers.
story_zh: 郑庄公既是周王朝廷的卿士，又是王畿旁边一个强国的国君，常常违背周王的意愿行事。公元前707年，周桓王撤掉了他的卿士职位。郑庄公从此不再朝见，桓王便亲率王师，联合陈、蔡、卫三国军队讨伐郑国。
两军在繻葛交战。郑军先攻击较弱的两翼联军，联军很快溃散；随后郑军以战车和步兵密切配合的“鱼丽之阵”合围王师中军。王师大败，郑国将领祝聃一箭射中了周王的肩膀。
祝聃想要追击，郑庄公阻止了他。当晚，庄公还派使者前去慰问周王和随行的大臣。
battle-of-xuge.why: A lord had defeated the king in open battle, and everyone saw that royal power was now mostly ceremonial.
battle-of-xuge.why_zh: 诸侯在战场上公开击败了周王，天下人都看清了王权已经名存实亡。

people.name: Zhu Dan
people.role: Zheng officer who shot the king

story: Guan Zhong had backed the losing prince in Qi's succession struggle and even shot at the winner. But when Duke Huan took the throne in 685 BCE, Bao Shuya persuaded him that Guan Zhong was the best man to run the state, and the duke made him chief minister.

According to the Discourses of the States, Guan Zhong divided the people into four groups: scholar-officers, farmers, craftsmen and merchants, each living in their own districts so skills passed from father to son. He linked local units to army units, so neighbours fought together. Land was taxed according to its quality. Later texts credit him with making salt and iron state businesses and with trading on Qi's coast.
Qi became the richest and strongest state of its day, ready to lead the others.
story_zh: 在齐国的君位之争中，管仲辅佐的是失败的一方，还曾向胜出的公子小白放箭。但公元前685年齐桓公即位后，鲍叔牙劝说他：治理国家，非管仲不可。桓公于是任命管仲为国相。
据《国语》记载，管仲把百姓分为士、农、工、商四类，各自聚居，技艺得以父子相传。他把乡里组织与军队编制结合起来，让邻里在战场上并肩作战。土地按照好坏等级征税。后来的文献还说，他把盐、铁收归官营，并利用齐国沿海的条件发展商贸。
齐国由此成为当时最富强的国家，具备了领导诸侯的实力。
guan-zhong-reforms.why: Guan Zhong's reforms made Qi the first hegemon and became a model for later statesmen who believed a strong state starts with a strong economy.
guan-zhong-reforms.why_zh: 管仲改革使齐国成为第一个霸主，也成为后世政治家“富国方能强兵”理念的典范。

quote.zh: 仓廪实则知礼节，衣食足则知荣辱。
quote.en: When the granaries are full, people know ritual and restraint; when food and clothing are sufficient, they know honour and shame.
quote.from: Guanzi, Mu Min 管子·牧民

story: In 684 BCE Duke Huan of Qi, newly on the throne, sent an army against Lu, which had backed his rival. Duke Zhuang of Lu prepared to fight. A commoner named Cao Gui asked to see the duke and went with him to battle in his chariot.

At Changshao the Qi army beat its drums to signal an attack. The duke wanted to answer at once, but Cao Gui told him to wait. Only after Qi had drummed three times did Lu charge, and Qi was routed. Cao Gui then checked the enemy's wheel tracks and flags before allowing a pursuit, to make sure the retreat was not a trick.
Afterwards he explained that courage rises with the first drumbeat, fades with the second and is gone by the third. When the enemy's spirit was spent and Lu's was full, Lu won.
story_zh: 公元前684年，刚即位的齐桓公出兵攻打曾支持他对手的鲁国。鲁庄公准备迎战。一个叫曹刿的平民求见庄公，并随他乘车出战。
两军在长勺对阵，齐军击鼓进攻。庄公想马上击鼓应战，曹刿让他等一等。直到齐军擂过三通鼓，鲁军才发起冲锋，齐军大败。曹刿又下车察看齐军的车辙，登车眺望齐军的旗帜，确认对方不是假装撤退之后，才同意追击。
战后他解释说：打仗靠的是勇气，第一通鼓时士气振作，第二通时开始减弱，到第三通时就耗尽了。敌方士气耗尽而我方士气正盛，所以能够取胜。
battle-of-changshao.why: Changshao became the classic Chinese lesson on timing and morale, and the story is still read in Chinese schools.
battle-of-changshao.why_zh: 长勺之战成为中国人讲时机与士气的经典战例，至今仍是中学语文课本中的名篇。

quote.zh: 一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。
quote.en: With the first drum, courage rises; with the second, it fades; with the third, it is gone.
quote.from: Zuo Commentary, Duke Zhuang year 10 左传·庄公十年

story: In 651 BCE Duke Huan of Qi called the lords of Lu, Song, Wey, Zheng, Xu, Cao and other states to Kuiqiu, on the plain east of today's Kaifeng. It was the high point of his career as hegemon.

King Xiang of Zhou sent his minister Zai Kong with sacrificial meat from the royal temple, a rare honour, and told Duke Huan he need not bow to receive it. Guan Zhong advised him to bow anyway, and the duke stepped down and bowed, showing respect for the king.

The lords swore a covenant. According to Mencius, it included rules such as: do not change a chosen heir, do not make a concubine the main wife, do not build dams that harm other states, do not stop grain sales in famine, and do not grant fiefs without reporting it.
story_zh: 公元前651年，齐桓公召集鲁、宋、卫、郑、许、曹等国诸侯在葵丘会盟，地点在今开封以东的平原上。这是他霸业的巅峰。
周襄王派宰孔送来宗庙祭肉，这是极高的礼遇，并特许齐桓公不必下拜受赐。管仲劝桓公还是要拜，于是桓公走下台阶跪拜接受，以示对周王的尊重。
诸侯共同立下盟约。据《孟子》记载，盟约中包括：不得擅自更换已立的太子，不得以妾为妻，不得修筑危害邻国的堤坝，饥荒时不得阻止粮食买卖，分封土地必须通告各国，等等。
covenant-of-kuiqiu.why: Kuiqiu showed the hegemon system at its best: a strong lord using the king's name to set common rules among the states.
covenant-of-kuiqiu.why_zh: 葵丘之盟展现了霸主体制最理想的一面：强国国君借周王的名义，为各国订立共同规则。

quote.zh: 无曲防，无遏籴，无有封而不告。
quote.en: Do not build dykes that harm others, do not block the sale of grain, and do not grant fiefs without announcing them.
quote.from: Mencius, Gaozi II 孟子·告子下

story: After Duke Huan of Qi died, Duke Xiang of Song hoped to become the next hegemon, although Song was not strong. In 638 BCE he attacked Zheng, an ally of Chu, and Chu sent an army to help Zheng.

The two armies met at the Hong River. Song was already in position when Chu began to cross. The Song minister Ziyu urged the duke to strike while the enemy was in the water. The duke refused. When Chu had crossed but was not yet in formation, Ziyu urged him again. Again he refused. Only after Chu was ready did Song attack, and it was crushed. The duke was wounded in the thigh.
He defended himself by saying a gentleman does not wound a man twice or capture the grey-haired. He died of his wound the next year.
story_zh: 齐桓公死后，宋襄公想继承霸业，可是宋国国力并不强。公元前638年，他出兵攻打楚国的盟国郑国，楚国随即发兵救郑。
两军在泓水相遇。宋军已经列好阵势，楚军开始渡河。大臣子鱼劝宋襄公趁敌军半渡时出击，襄公不肯；楚军过河后还没排好阵，子鱼再次劝他进攻，他还是不肯。等楚军列阵完毕，宋军才发起进攻，结果大败，襄公大腿也受了伤。
他为自己辩解说，君子不伤害已经受伤的人，也不俘虏头发花白的老人。第二年，他因伤重去世。
battle-of-hong.why: The battle marked the end of the old code of chivalry in war, and Duke Xiang's 'benevolence' became a byword for foolish rigidity.
battle-of-hong.why_zh: 这场战役标志着旧式战争礼仪的终结，宋襄公的“仁义”也成了迂腐的代名词。

quote.zh: 君子不重伤，不禽二毛。
quote.en: A gentleman does not wound a man twice, nor take the grey-haired prisoner.
quote.from: Zuo Commentary, Duke Xi year 22 左传·僖公二十二年

story: Chong'er was a son of Duke Xian of Jin. When his father's favourite consort plotted to put her own son on the throne, he fled in 655 BCE. For nineteen years he wandered among the Di people and the states of Wey, Qi, Cao, Song, Zheng, Chu and Qin. Some rulers welcomed him; others treated him with contempt.
A small group of loyal followers stayed with him, among them his uncle Hu Yan and Zhao Cui. Legend says that when he was starving, Jie Zitui cut flesh from his own thigh to feed him.

In 636 BCE Duke Mu of Qin sent an army to escort him home. His nephew Duke Huai was killed, and Chong'er, already in his sixties, took the throne as Duke Wen. He rewarded his followers, reformed the army and won the trust of the people.
story_zh: 重耳是晋献公的儿子。献公的宠妃骊姬想让自己的儿子继位，设计陷害诸公子，重耳于公元前655年出逃。此后十九年间，他辗转于狄人部落以及卫、齐、曹、宋、郑、楚、秦等国，有的君主热情相待，有的则对他十分无礼。
一小批忠心的随从始终跟着他，其中有他的舅舅狐偃和赵衰。传说他饥饿难耐时，介子推割下自己大腿上的肉给他吃。
公元前636年，秦穆公派兵护送他回国，他的侄子晋怀公被杀，年过六十的重耳即位，就是晋文公。他奖赏随从，整顿军队，赢得了民心。
chonger-returns.why: Within four years Duke Wen made Jin the leading state, and his story of exile and return became one of the best-loved tales of the era.
chonger-returns.why_zh: 仅仅四年后，晋文公就使晋国成为霸主；他流亡归国的故事也成为这个时代最脍炙人口的传奇之一。

people.name: Chong'er
people.role: Prince of Jin, later Duke Wen
people.role_zh: 晋国公子，后来的晋文公

people.name: Duke Mu of Qin
people.role: Ruler of Qin who escorted him home

story: In 628 BCE Duke Mu of Qin decided to seize Zheng in a surprise attack, though it meant marching far through Jin territory. His old minister Jian Shu warned against it and wept as the army left, saying he would collect his son's bones in the Xiao mountains.

In 627 BCE, near Zheng, the Qin army met a Zheng cattle merchant named Xian Gao. Pretending to be an envoy, he offered twelve oxen as a gift for the troops, which told the Qin generals that Zheng knew they were coming. They gave up, destroyed the small state of Hua instead and turned for home.

Jin, led by Xian Zhen, ambushed them in the narrow Xiao mountain passes. The Qin army was wiped out and its three generals, including Meng Mingshi, were captured. Jin's dowager, a Qin princess, persuaded the new duke to release them.
story_zh: 公元前628年，秦穆公决定偷袭郑国，尽管这意味着要穿过晋国领土长途行军。老臣蹇叔竭力劝阻，大军出发时他哭着说，他将到崤山去收他儿子的尸骨。
公元前627年，秦军在郑国附近遇到郑国牛贩弦高。弦高假称奉郑君之命前来，献上十二头牛犒劳秦军。秦军将领由此判断郑国已有防备，只好放弃偷袭，转而灭掉了小国滑国，随后回师。
晋军在先轸指挥下，在崤山狭窄的山道中伏击秦军。秦军全军覆没，孟明视等三位将领被俘。晋襄公的嫡母文嬴是秦国公主，她劝说襄公放走了他们。
battle-of-xiao.why: Xiao turned Qin and Jin from allies into enemies and blocked Qin's way east, forcing it to expand west instead.
battle-of-xiao.why_zh: 崤之战使秦、晋由盟友变为仇敌，也堵住了秦国东进的道路，迫使它转向西方发展。

people.name: Xian Gao
people.role: Zheng merchant who fooled the Qin army

people.name: Jian Shu
people.role: Qin minister who warned against the raid

story: Duke Mu of Qin was an ambitious ruler who recruited talented men from other states, such as Baili Xi, a former minister of Yu said to have been bought for five ram skins. He helped put Duke Wen on the throne of Jin, but after the disaster at Xiao in 627 BCE the road east was closed.

Duke Mu turned west. He won over You Yu, an adviser of the Rong king, and used his knowledge of the Rong to plan his campaigns. In 623 BCE, the Records of the Grand Historian say, Qin added twelve states, opened a thousand li of land and became master of the western Rong. The Zhou king sent him a gift of a bronze drum in recognition.
When Duke Mu died in 621 BCE, 177 people were buried with him, an act lamented in the Classic of Poetry.
story_zh: 秦穆公雄心勃勃，善于从别国招揽人才，例如原虞国大夫百里奚，相传是用五张黑公羊皮换来的。他曾帮助晋文公登上君位，但公元前627年崤之战惨败后，东进之路被堵死了。
秦穆公于是转向西方。他争取到戎王的谋臣由余，并依靠由余对戎人的了解来谋划征战。据《史记》记载，公元前623年，秦国兼并了十二个国家，开拓疆土千里，称霸西戎。周王还派人赐给他一面金鼓以示嘉奖。
公元前621年秦穆公去世，殉葬者多达177人，《诗经》中有诗哀悼此事。
qin-dominates-rong.why: Control of the western frontier gave Qin land, horses and manpower, and made it one of the great powers of the age.
qin-dominates-rong.why_zh: 掌控西部边疆为秦国带来了土地、马匹和人力，使它跻身当时的大国之列。

people.name: You Yu
people.role: Former adviser to the Rong king

quote.zh: 益国十二，开地千里，遂霸西戎。
quote.en: He added twelve states, opened up a thousand li of land, and so became hegemon over the western Rong.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian, Annals of Qin 史记·秦本纪

story: The Records of the Grand Historian say that for the first three years of his reign King Zhuang of Chu did nothing but feast. When a minister asked him in a riddle about a bird that neither flew nor sang for three years, the king answered that once it flew it would soar to the sky, and once it sang it would astonish everyone. He then took charge of government.

In 606 BCE he attacked the Rong of Luhun and marched his army up to the Luo River, on the border of the royal domain. King Ding of Zhou sent Wangsun Man to greet him. King Zhuang asked how large and heavy the nine cauldrons were. These bronze vessels, said to date from Yu the Great, were the symbol of the right to rule all under Heaven.
Wangsun Man replied that the right to rule depended on virtue, not on the cauldrons. King Zhuang withdrew.
story_zh: 据《史记》记载，楚庄王即位后头三年整日饮酒作乐，不理政事。有大臣用隐语问他：有一只鸟三年不飞也不叫，这是什么鸟？庄王回答：三年不飞，一飞冲天；三年不鸣，一鸣惊人。此后他便亲理朝政。
公元前606年，楚庄王讨伐陆浑之戎，一直进军到周王畿边界的洛水之滨，在那里陈兵示威。周定王派王孙满前去慰劳。庄王向他打听九鼎的大小和轻重。九鼎相传是大禹铸造的，是统治天下的象征。
王孙满回答说：统治天下在于德行，不在于鼎。楚庄王于是退兵。
chu-asks-about-cauldrons.why: 'Asking about the cauldrons' became the Chinese phrase for aiming to seize supreme power, and Chu soon proved its strength at Bi.
chu-asks-about-cauldrons.why_zh: “问鼎”从此成为觊觎最高权力的代名词，而楚国不久便在邲之战中证明了自己的实力。

quote.zh: 在德不在鼎。
quote.en: It depends on virtue, not on the cauldrons.
quote.from: Zuo Commentary, Duke Xuan year 3 左传·宣公三年

story: The Classic of Poetry contains 305 songs and poems composed from about the 11th to the 6th century BCE. It has three parts: the Airs of the States, folk-style songs from fifteen regions; the Elegantiae, songs of the Zhou court; and the Hymns, sung at ancestral sacrifices.

The poems describe farming, war, love, marriage, feasting and complaint against harsh rulers. By the middle of the Spring and Autumn period the collection was largely complete. In 544 BCE the Wu prince Ji Zha visited Lu and heard musicians perform songs from the different states in an order close to today's book.
Tradition says Confucius chose the 305 poems from three thousand, though most scholars doubt this. He taught his students to study the Odes, and they were quoted constantly in diplomacy and debate.
story_zh: 《诗经》收录了305篇诗歌，创作时间大约从公元前11世纪到前6世纪，分为三部分：《风》是十五个地区的民间风格歌谣，《雅》是周王室的朝廷乐歌，《颂》是宗庙祭祀时演唱的颂歌。
这些诗歌描写了农耕、战争、爱情、婚姻、宴饮，也有对暴政的怨刺。到春秋中期，这部诗集已基本成形。公元前544年，吴国公子季札访问鲁国，听乐工演奏各国诗乐，其顺序与今本《诗经》相当接近。
相传孔子从三千多篇中删选出这305篇，但多数学者对此存疑。孔子要求学生学《诗》，诸侯外交和辩论中也经常引用诗句。
classic-of-poetry.why: It is China's oldest collection of poetry and became one of the Confucian classics, shaping Chinese literature for more than two millennia.
classic-of-poetry.why_zh: 它是中国最早的诗歌总集，后来成为儒家经典之一，影响了中国文学两千多年。

people.name: Ji Zha
people.role: Wu prince who heard the songs in Lu
people.role_zh: 在鲁国观乐的吴国公子

quote.zh: 诗三百，一言以蔽之，曰：思无邪。
quote.en: The three hundred Odes can be summed up in one phrase: no twisted thoughts.
quote.from: Analects, Wei Zheng 论语·为政

story: In 597 BCE King Zhuang of Chu besieged Zheng for three months until it surrendered. Jin sent a large army under Xun Linfu to relieve Zheng, but by the time it reached the Yellow River, Zheng had already made peace with Chu.

The Jin commanders could not agree. Xun Linfu wanted to go home, but the general Xian Hu crossed the river with his own troops, and the rest of the army followed. Chu attacked quickly while Jin was divided. The Jin army broke and fled to the river.

In the panic to cross, soldiers already in the boats hacked at the hands of those clinging to the sides, and the Zuo Commentary says the fingers in the boats could be scooped up by the handful. King Zhuang refused to build a victory monument of enemy corpses, saying that true martial power means stopping war.
story_zh: 公元前597年，楚庄王围攻郑国三个月，郑国被迫投降。晋国派荀林父率大军救郑，但大军赶到黄河边时，郑国已经和楚国讲和了。
晋军将领意见不一。荀林父主张回国，副将先縠却擅自带领本部渡河，其余部队只得跟进。楚军趁晋军不和迅速进攻，晋军溃败，逃向黄河。
争渡时，先上船的士兵挥刀砍那些攀住船舷的人的手，据《左传》记载，船里被砍落的手指多得可以用手捧起来。战后楚庄王拒绝用晋军尸体筑“京观”炫耀战功，他说：真正的“武”，是止息战争。
battle-of-bi.why: Bi made King Zhuang the leading ruler of his time and Chu the equal of Jin for the rest of the period.
battle-of-bi.why_zh: 邲之战使楚庄王成为当时的霸主，此后楚国在整个春秋时期都与晋国旗鼓相当。

people.name: Xian Hu
people.role: Jin general who crossed without orders

quote.zh: 舟中之指可掬也。
quote.en: The fingers in the boats could be scooped up in handfuls.
quote.from: Zuo Commentary, Duke Xuan year 12 左传·宣公十二年

story: Under the older system described in later texts as the 'well-field' system, farmers worked the lord's public field together and kept the harvest of their own plots. In practice, more and more land was being cleared and held privately outside this system and paid nothing.

In 594 BCE, the fifteenth year of Duke Xuan, Lu began to tax all farmland according to its area, whether it was old or newly opened. The Spring and Autumn Annals record the change in three words, and the Zuo Commentary criticises it as against ritual.
It brought more grain into the treasury but also accepted that the land now belonged to those who farmed or held it. Other states made similar changes over the following decades.
story_zh: 按照后世文献所说的“井田制”，农民要共同耕种领主的公田，自己份地上的收成归自己。但实际上，越来越多的土地在这个体制之外被开垦出来，归私人所有，却不用纳税。
公元前594年（鲁宣公十五年），鲁国开始对所有耕地按面积征税，无论是公田还是新开垦的私田。《春秋》只用“初税亩”三个字记载了这一变化，《左传》则批评它“非礼也”。
这一改革增加了国家收入，同时也默认了土地归耕种者或占有者所有。此后几十年里，其他诸侯国也陆续进行了类似的改革。
lu-land-tax.why: Taxing land by area recognised private landholding and marked the start of the end of the old Zhou land system.
lu-land-tax.why_zh: 按亩征税等于承认了土地私有，标志着周代旧土地制度开始瓦解。

quote.zh: 初税亩，非礼也。
quote.en: Taxing the fields by area for the first time: this was against ritual.
quote.from: Zuo Commentary, Duke Xuan year 15 左传·宣公十五年

story: In 575 BCE Zheng broke with Jin and joined Chu. Duke Li of Jin led an army south to punish it, and King Gong of Chu came north with his army to protect his new ally. They met at Yanling, south-east of Zheng.

Chu drew up its army right against the Jin camp at dawn. The Jin commanders filled in their wells and flattened their cooking stoves to make room to form up inside the camp. In the battle, the Jin officer Lü Qi shot King Gong in the eye. Chu was driven back, but its army was still intact at nightfall.
That night the Chu commander Zifan was drunk when the king called for him. Unable to plan the next day's battle, King Gong withdrew. Zifan took his own life.
story_zh: 公元前575年，郑国背叛晋国，投靠了楚国。晋厉公率军南下讨伐郑国，楚共王也率军北上救援新盟友，两军在郑国东南的鄢陵相遇。
黎明时楚军紧逼晋营列阵。晋军将领下令填平水井、铲平灶台，在营中腾出空地布阵。交战中，晋将吕锜一箭射中楚共王的眼睛。楚军被击退，但到天黑时主力仍然完整。
当晚楚共王召见主帅子反商议军情，子反却喝醉了。楚共王无法部署第二天的战斗，只好撤军，子反随后自杀。
battle-of-yanling.why: Yanling kept Jin ahead of Chu for another generation, but both powers were growing tired of endless war.
battle-of-yanling.why_zh: 鄢陵之战让晋国又领先楚国一代人之久，但两国都已对无休止的战争感到厌倦。

people.name: Lü Qi
people.role: Jin officer who shot the king

story: By the middle of the 6th century BCE Jin and Chu had fought each other for nearly a hundred years, and the small states between them, such as Zheng and Song, suffered most. Xiang Xu, a minister of Song, was on good terms with leaders in both great states and proposed a peace.

In 546 BCE delegates from fourteen states met at the Song capital. Zhao Wu led the Jin delegation and Qu Jian the Chu delegation. They agreed that the allies of each power would also pay respects to the other, so that Jin and Chu shared leadership. The two great powers argued over which would swear first; Jin finally let Chu go first.
The truce largely held. Jin and Chu did not fight a major battle against each other for about forty years after the meeting.
story_zh: 到公元前六世纪中叶，晋、楚两国已争斗了近百年，夹在中间的郑、宋等小国受害最深。宋国大夫向戌与两大国的执政者都有交情，于是倡议停战。
公元前546年，十四个诸侯国的代表在宋国都城会盟。晋国由赵武率领，楚国由屈建率领。各方约定，晋、楚两国的盟国都要同时朝见对方，晋、楚共同做诸侯的霸主。两大国还为谁先歃血争执不下，最终晋国让楚国先歃。
这次停战基本得到了遵守。会后约四十年间，晋、楚之间再没有发生大规模战争。
conference-of-song.why: The conference ended the long Jin-Chu duel and shifted the main conflicts of the late period to the rise of Wu and Yue in the southeast.
conference-of-song.why_zh: 弭兵之会结束了晋、楚长期对峙的局面，春秋后期的主要冲突转向东南方吴、越两国的崛起。

people.name: Xiang Xu
people.role: Song minister who arranged the peace

story: Zichan led the government of Zheng from 543 BCE, a small state squeezed between Jin and Chu. He reorganised field boundaries and irrigation ditches, introduced new military levies, and refused to close the village schools where people criticised the government, saying he would learn from what they said.
In 536 BCE he had Zheng's penal laws cast on bronze cauldrons and put on public display. It was the first time a Chinese state published its laws for all to read.

Shuxiang, a respected minister of Jin, wrote him a sharp letter. If people knew the laws, he argued, they would stop respecting their superiors and would argue over the wording. Zichan replied politely that he lacked the talent to plan for future generations; he was trying to save his own.
story_zh: 子产从公元前543年起执掌郑国国政，当时郑国夹在晋、楚两强之间。他整顿田界和沟渠，推行新的军赋制度，还拒绝拆毁百姓议论朝政的乡校，说可以从百姓的议论中学习。
公元前536年，他把郑国的刑法铸在青铜鼎上公之于众。这是中国历史上第一次由国家公布成文法，让所有人都能看到。
晋国名臣叔向写信严厉批评他：百姓一旦知道了法律条文，就不再敬畏上级，还会为条文的字句争来争去。子产客气地回信说：我没有才能去为子孙后代考虑，我这样做是为了挽救当今的世道。
zichan-law-code.why: Publishing the law was a turning point from rule by custom and noble judgment toward written law known to all.
zichan-law-code.why_zh: 公布成文法是一个转折点，标志着从依靠习俗和贵族裁断的统治，走向人人可知的成文法。

quote.zh: 吾以救世也。
quote.en: I do it to save my own generation.
quote.from: Zuo Commentary, Duke Zhao year 6 左传·昭公六年

story: Wu She was tutor to the crown prince of Chu. In 522 BCE King Ping of Chu, persuaded by a rival minister, turned against the prince and arrested Wu She. The king summoned Wu She's two sons, promising to spare their father if they came.

The elder son, Wu Shang, went knowing it was a trap, and both he and his father were killed. The younger son, Wu Yun, known as Wu Zixu, refused and fled. Passing through Song and Zheng, he made his way east. Later stories describe him slipping past the guards at the Zhao Pass and being ferried across the Yangtze by a fisherman.
In Wu he introduced the assassin Zhuan Zhu to Prince Guang, helping him seize the throne in 515 BCE as King Helü. Wu Zixu became his chief adviser.
story_zh: 伍奢是楚国太子的老师。公元前522年，楚平王听信奸臣谗言，与太子反目，逮捕了伍奢。平王召伍奢的两个儿子进京，许诺只要他们来，就赦免他们的父亲。
长子伍尚明知是陷阱，仍然前往，结果父子二人都被杀害。次子伍员，字子胥，拒绝前往，出逃他乡。他经过宋国和郑国，一路向东。后世故事说他偷偷混过昭关守卫，又由一位渔夫摆渡过了长江。
到吴国后，他把刺客专诸推荐给公子光，帮助公子光于公元前515年夺取王位，即吴王阖闾。伍子胥从此成为阖闾的首席谋臣。
wu-zixu-flees.why: Wu Zixu's thirst for revenge drove Wu's war against Chu, leading to the fall of the Chu capital in 506 BCE.
wu-zixu-flees.why_zh: 伍子胥的复仇之心推动了吴国对楚国的战争，最终导致楚都在公元前506年陷落。

people.name: Wu Zixu
people.role: Chu noble who fled to Wu

people.name: Wu She
people.role: His father, tutor to the crown prince

story: In 513 BCE, during a military campaign, the Jin ministers Zhao Yang and Xun Yin collected a levy of iron from the people of Jin. They used it to cast a cauldron and inscribed on it the penal code drawn up decades earlier by the minister Fan Xuanzi.

The Zuo Commentary records that Confucius criticised the act. He said Jin would perish because it had abandoned its proper standards: once the laws were on a cauldron, people would look to the cauldron rather than respect the nobles.
This is one of the earliest dated mentions of iron in Chinese texts. By this time iron tools and cast iron were beginning to spread, which would soon change farming and warfare.
story_zh: 公元前513年，晋国卿大夫赵鞅和荀寅在一次出兵途中，向晋国百姓征收了一批铁，用来铸造一只鼎，并把几十年前范宣子制定的刑书铸在鼎上。
据《左传》记载，孔子批评这一做法，说晋国恐怕要灭亡了，因为它丢掉了应有的法度：法律一旦铸在鼎上，百姓就只看鼎上的条文，而不再尊敬贵族了。
这是中国文献中关于铁的最早有确切年代的记载之一。当时铁制工具和铸铁技术正开始推广，不久便改变了农业生产和战争的面貌。
jin-penal-cauldron.why: Following Zheng, a great power now published its laws, and the use of iron showed a new technology entering the state's service.
jin-penal-cauldron.why_zh: 继郑国之后，大国晋国也公布了成文法；而用铁铸鼎，表明一种新技术开始为国家所用。

people.name: Zhao Yang
people.role: Jin minister, also known as Zhao Jianzi

quote.zh: 晋其亡乎！失其度矣。
quote.en: Jin will surely perish! It has lost its proper standards.
quote.from: Zuo Commentary, Duke Zhao year 29 左传·昭公二十九年

story: The Records of the Grand Historian say that Sun Wu, a man of Qi, came to Wu and presented his thirteen chapters on war to King Helü. To test him, the king asked him to drill the palace women. When they giggled at his orders, Sun Wu had the king's two favourite concubines, who served as squad leaders, executed. After that the women obeyed perfectly, and Helü made him a general.
The book teaches that war is a grave matter of state. It stresses planning, knowing yourself and your enemy, deception, speed and winning without fighting if possible.
Sun Wu does not appear in the Zuo Commentary, so some historians doubt the story, and the text was probably expanded later. In 1972 bamboo copies were found in a Han tomb at Yinqueshan, Shandong.
story_zh: 据《史记》记载，齐国人孙武来到吴国，把他的兵法十三篇献给吴王阖闾。阖闾想考考他，让他操练宫中女子。宫女们对他的号令嘻嘻哈哈，孙武就把担任队长的两名吴王宠姬斩首。此后宫女们令行禁止，阖闾于是任命他为将军。
这部兵书开篇就说，战争是关系国家存亡的大事。书中强调周密谋划、知己知彼、兵不厌诈、兵贵神速，以及尽可能不战而屈人之兵。
由于《左传》中没有提到孙武，一些史学家对这个故事存疑，书的内容也可能经过后人增补。1972年，山东临沂银雀山汉墓出土了它的竹简抄本。
art-of-war.why: The Art of War is the most famous work of military strategy from ancient China and is still read worldwide in business and politics as well as war.
art-of-war.why_zh: 《孙子兵法》是中国古代最著名的兵书，至今仍在世界各地的军事、商业和政治领域被广泛研读。

quote.zh: 兵者，国之大事，死生之地，存亡之道，不可不察也。
quote.en: War is a vital matter of the state, the ground of life and death, the road to survival or ruin. It must be studied with care.
quote.from: The Art of War, Laying Plans 孙子兵法·计篇

story: In 496 BCE King Helü of Wu attacked Yue and was badly defeated at Zuili. He was wounded in the foot and died soon after. His son Fuchai took the throne and, the histories say, had a servant remind him every day not to forget that Yue had killed his father.

In 494 BCE King Goujian of Yue struck first, but Fuchai crushed him at Fujiao, by Lake Tai. Goujian fled to Mount Kuaiji with five thousand men and was surrounded. His minister Wen Zhong bribed the Wu minister Bo Pi to argue for peace.

Wu Zixu urged Fuchai to destroy Yue completely, warning that otherwise it would rise again. Fuchai accepted Yue's surrender instead. By later accounts Goujian went to Wu and served Fuchai as a humble servant before being allowed home.
story_zh: 公元前496年，吴王阖闾进攻越国，在槜李大败，脚上受伤，不久去世。他的儿子夫差即位。史书记载，夫差让人每天提醒他：不要忘记越国杀了你的父亲。
公元前494年，越王勾践抢先出兵，却在太湖边的夫椒被夫差打得大败。勾践带着五千残兵逃到会稽山，被吴军团团围住。越国大夫文种贿赂吴国太宰伯嚭，让他替越国求和。
伍子胥力劝夫差彻底灭掉越国，警告说否则后患无穷。夫差却接受了越国的投降。据后来的记载，勾践亲自到吴国为夫差做奴仆，后来才被放回国。
battle-of-fujiao.why: Fuchai's mercy at Fujiao set up one of China's most famous revenge stories: Goujian rebuilt Yue and destroyed Wu twenty years later.
battle-of-fujiao.why_zh: 夫差在夫椒之战后的宽容，引出了中国历史上最著名的复仇故事之一：勾践重振越国，二十年后灭掉了吴国。

people.name: Wen Zhong
people.role: Yue minister who arranged the surrender

story: After defeating Yue, Fuchai of Wu wanted to challenge the northern states, especially Qi. Moving troops and supplies from the Yangtze to the Huai valley by land was slow, so he decided to link the rivers by water.

In 486 BCE Wu built a walled town at Han, near today's Yangzhou, and dug a canal northward through a chain of lakes to the Huai River near today's Huai'an. The Zuo Commentary records it in a single line. Wu then attacked Qi, and in 484 BCE it crushed the Qi army at Ailing.
The Han Canal, or Hangou, is one of the earliest dated canals in China. Later dynasties rebuilt it many times, and it became part of the Grand Canal.
story_zh: 打败越国后，吴王夫差想向北方的诸侯，尤其是齐国发起挑战。从长江到淮河走陆路运兵运粮十分缓慢，他便决定用水道把两条大河连起来。
公元前486年，吴国在邗（今江苏扬州附近）筑城，并向北开凿运河，借助沿途一连串湖泊，在今淮安附近与淮河相接。《左传》只用一句话记下了这件事。此后吴国接连进攻齐国，公元前484年在艾陵大败齐军。
邗沟是中国有确切年代记载的最早运河之一。后世多次重修，最终成为京杭大运河的一部分。
han-canal.why: The Han Canal joined China's two great river systems for the first time and was the first section of what became the Grand Canal.
han-canal.why_zh: 邗沟首次把中国两大水系连接起来，成为后来大运河最早的一段。

quote.zh: 吴城邗，沟通江、淮。
quote.en: Wu walled Han and dug a channel linking the Yangtze and the Huai.
quote.from: Zuo Commentary, Duke Ai year 9 左传·哀公九年

story: After beating Qi at Ailing in 484 BCE, Fuchai of Wu wanted to be recognised as leader of all the lords. In 482 BCE he took his best troops north and met Duke Ding of Jin and other lords at Huangchi, near the Yellow River.
Wu and Jin argued over which ruler should swear the covenant first, as the senior power. Different sources disagree over who won the dispute.

While Fuchai was away, King Goujian of Yue attacked Wu. Yue defeated the army left at home, captured the crown prince and entered the capital. Fuchai kept the news secret, reportedly killing messengers so that the lords would not hear. He then hurried home and sent rich gifts to Yue to ask for peace.
story_zh: 公元前484年在艾陵打败齐国后，吴王夫差想成为天下诸侯公认的霸主。公元前482年，他率领精锐北上，在黄河附近的黄池与晋定公等诸侯会盟。
吴、晋两国为谁作为盟主先歃血争执不下。不同史料对最后谁占上风的记载并不一致。
就在夫差北上期间，越王勾践出兵攻吴，打败留守的吴军，俘虏了太子，攻入吴都。夫差封锁消息，据说还杀掉了报信的人，以免被诸侯知道。随后他匆忙回国，派人带着厚礼向越国求和。
meeting-at-huangchi.why: Huangchi was the peak of Wu's power, but it exposed its home to Yue, which destroyed Wu nine years later.
meeting-at-huangchi.why_zh: 黄池之会是吴国国力的顶点，却让国内空虚、给了越国可乘之机，九年后吴国被越国所灭。

story: The Tian, also called Chen, family came to Qi as refugees from the state of Chen in the 670s BCE. Over generations they won support by lending grain with a large measure and taking repayment with a small one, and by building alliances with other noble houses.

In 481 BCE Tian Chang clashed with Kan Zhi, a favourite of Duke Jian of Qi. Tian Chang's men killed Kan Zhi, and the duke fled and was caught and killed at Shuzhou. Tian Chang put the duke's brother on the throne as Duke Ping and took control of the government. The Analects record that Confucius, then in Lu, asked his ruler to punish the murder, but nothing was done.
From then on the Tian ruled Qi in practice. In 386 BCE the Zhou king formally recognised Tian He as lord of Qi.
story_zh: 田氏又称陈氏，公元前七世纪70年代从陈国逃难来到齐国。此后几代人里，他们用大斗借出粮食、用小斗收回，以此收买人心，并与其他贵族结成联盟。
公元前481年，田常与齐简公的宠臣阚止发生冲突。田常的部下杀死了阚止，齐简公出逃，在舒州被抓获杀害。田常拥立简公的弟弟为国君，即齐平公，自己掌握了国政。据《论语》记载，当时身在鲁国的孔子请求鲁君出兵讨伐弑君者，但没有结果。
此后田氏成为齐国的实际统治者。公元前386年，周王正式承认田和为齐国国君。
tian-family-qi.why: The Tian takeover, like the split of Jin soon after, showed that ministers could now replace their lords, a sign of the coming Warring States era.
tian-family-qi.why_zh: 田氏掌控齐国与不久之后的三家分晋一样，表明卿大夫已经可以取代国君，这预示着战国时代的到来。

people.name: Duke Jian of Qi
people.role: Ruler of Qi, killed in 481 BCE
people.role_zh: 公元前481年被杀的齐国国君

quote.zh: 以家量贷，而以公量收之。
quote.en: They lent with their family's measure and collected with the duke's measure.
quote.from: Zuo Commentary, Duke Zhao year 3 左传·昭公三年
